args.sql: SELECT count(*) as cnt, sum(amount) as total_cents FROM memory.bench.orders WHERE status='completed' AND order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-10-01 00:00:00' AND order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 00:00:00'
SELECT order_id, order_ts, typeof(order_ts) FROM memory.bench.orders LIMIT 3
SELECT count(*) cnt, sum(amount) total_cents FROM memory.bench.orders WHERE status='completed' AND year(order_ts)=2025 AND month(order_ts) IN (10,11,12)

transcript.text:
Both approaches agree: 242 completed orders in Q4 2025, total amount = 40,351,809 (in cents, since amounts appear to be stored as integer cents based on legacy_orders comparison: e.g., amount=58692 corresponds to total=586.92).

Converting to dollars: 40,351,809 / 100 = $403,518.09

FINAL ANSWER: 403518.09
